notes.title: 20/5/2019 - Update
notes.content:
Dear all,

after a lot of requests, with this update I have nerfed the boss of Porto Gemma.

"Harmony of the bravest" is almost one year old and I want to say thank you for your trust!
I have not found a Mac computer to make an Apple version yet, I hope I can do that soon!

[i]LSGames[/i]

notes.title: Update and future plans
notes.content:
There's a new update!
Thanks to Olivia's plugin (https://fallenangelolivia.itch.io/), now encounters have been considerably reduced and escaping from battles is assured. 

I don't think there will be more updates since I think the game is complete now and I'm already working on the document of my next game, which won't see light before a lot of years I suppose.
Thank you for your support and for buying Harmony of the bravest!
See you later!
